title: EarnHFT: Efficient Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for High Frequency Trading

title: FlowHFT: Imitation Learning via Flow Matching Policy for Optimal High-Frequency Trading under Diverse Market Conditions
description: FlowHFT introduces a flow-matching imitation learning approach for high-frequency trading, enabling agents to learn optimal trading policies from expert demonstrations across diverse and dynamic market conditions.
